_comment: Long-form per-game data consumed by the about pages and by the JSON-LD generator in src/data/games.ts. Structured fields (genre, robloxGameId, etc.) mirror catalog data so a single source can populate both schema.org markup and the LLM-facing /llms.txt without re-reading the engineering catalog. Fields are intentionally optional on the consumer side; missing values are dropped from schema output.

body: ERADICATION drops contractors into a town that is no longer under control. The streets belong to Furries. The job is to take them back, hold them, and then deal with what is underneath the town.

Contractors begin at Whiskerhold, the only foothold left. Furward, Furrow, Purridge, Whisken, Bloodwhisk Reach, and Whiskspire begin in Furry hands. A flag is not yours because you reached it; it is yours when the Furries are off it and your side has held the ground long enough for the town to change hands.

Furries are not one creature with different health bars. Some chase, some hold flags, some shoot from range, some are dangerous when they die. Pressure scales with the player count and the mode, so cleared streets do not stay quiet.

Three modes are live. Traditional is the 48-minute full reclamation push that opens the boss route once the six territories are taken. Rush is a 7:30 single-objective hold on Furrow with every weapon unlocked and no boss. Infection is a 15-minute mode where Furry-held flags produce spawn pressure and downed contractors can come back on the wrong side.

Weapons decide the kind of mistake a contractor can survive. Vehicles, Blackhawks, armor, and rocket platforms move the team across ground that is no longer worth walking. None of them make the landing zone safe.

When the six reclaimable territories are taken in Traditional, the route goes below the town. Through the basement of a random house, down a tunnel, there is a large unnamed man surrounded by small Furries. No special title. No named mechanics. Just him.
features: Seven named territories with flag capture, contest, and ownership tracked per round
Eight Furry types with distinct behavior — chasers, ranged Spitters, exploding Pimples and Bloaters, fast Robots, heavy Leaders, Watchers, and boss-area Helpers
Three modes: Traditional (48m, boss enabled), Rush (7:30, single objective, all weapons unlocked), Infection (15m, downed contractors convert)
Boss event gated behind reclaiming all six territories — cutscene, atmosphere shift, tunnel den, helper waves, and a large unnamed man at the end of it
Deep weapon roster spanning pistols, SMGs, rifles, shotguns, machine guns, anti-materiel rifles, and rockets
Vehicles, helicopters, and armor — ATVs, Humvees, JLTVs, Mastiff, Centurion, MBT-800, Panzer IV, T-34-76, MH-60 Blackhawk, rocket-armed transport
Saved loadouts, cash and XP progression, daily and group rewards, and challenge tracking for captures, defenses, headshots, sidearm work, and clean lives
Player counts scale up to 32, with Furry population and boss difficulty tuned to the lobby
